purpose: Source-linked nutrient matching manifest for Food & Life. Numeric values are never guessed.

primary_source.name: K-FIND / MFDS Food Nutrient Database
match_rules: canonical or alias name must match semantically
species and meat cut must agree when specified
store source record id and source food name
never display a numeric nutrient value without provenance

fallback_source.name: USDA FoodData Central
fallback_source.use_when: No appropriate K-FIND record exists for a global ingredient
fallback_source.rule: Keep source provenance and do not silently mix preparation states.

ui_policy.verified: Show nutrient values and source label.
ui_policy.pending: Show 영양정보 확인 중 instead of fabricated numbers.
ui_policy.ambiguous: Ask user to choose raw/cooked or a specific variety/cut.
